chunks.text: Day eight. You voted A... striker. The special match. A charity game. And then... he walked out of the tunnel.
I froze. He laughed and said: let's see what you got.
Skill one. The outside-foot pass. No look. Just vision.
Skill two. The body feint. Drop the shoulder... go the other way.
Skill three. The curler. Inside of the foot... wrap it around the keeper.
Then we played. Same team. He found me with an outside-foot pass... and I curled it in!
After the game he said... if this video gets fifty likes, he'll try to get me to Barcelona. Fifty likes! Smash that like button!
Card check. Shooting: twenty-eight to thirty-two. Dribbling: thirty to thirty-four. Overall... thirty!
